title: fix(cli): os start leaves no process of its group behind on SIGTERM
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D7K4emLL9dNcp4rQPn22Dw)_

Fixes #34337

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `objectstack start` 收到 SIGTERM 退出时，它的进程组里不再残留进程。`serve` 载入 `objectstack.config.ts` 后立即关掉打包器 esbuild 的常驻服务进程。
- **为什么改：** 这个 esbuild 服务进程要等 `serve` 退出后才走，所以 `start` 退出那一刻它还在。容器运行时、systemd、多副本演练这类监管者读到「已停」时，组里其实还有进程。
- **风险与回滚：** 低。只在 `serve` 用配置文件启动时，于启动阶段多一次 esbuild `stop()`;之后再有 esbuild 调用会自动重开服务。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts`(`stopConfigBundler` 与原因)、`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`(唯一调用点)、`packages/cli/test/start-sigterm-process-group.integration.test.ts`;`scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` 的名单因新测试加一项(21→22)。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build && cd packages/cli && npx vitest run --project integration test/start-sigterm-process-group.integration.test.ts`,预期 1 passed。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`os start` already forwards SIGTERM to its `serve` child and exits with the child's code once the child has exited (`ServeRestartCoordinator`, #21114). The process the card's drill found alive is the child of `serve`, not `serve` itself.

On a config project, `serve` bundles `objectstack.config.ts` through `bundle-require`, which runs esbuild's async API. esbuild serves that API from a long-lived `esbuild --service` child process, and that child leaves only when it reads end-of-file on its stdin, a moment after its parent has exited. So when `start` exited, the bundler service was still in its process group.

`serve` now calls esbuild's `stop()` right after the config module loads (`stopConfigBundler` in `utils/config.ts`, one call site in `commands/serve.ts`). The service exits at boot while `serve` is alive to reap it, so the group a SIGTERM later finds is `start` and `serve` only. Boots with `--artifact`/`--artifact-fallback` or `--prebuilt` never start the bundler and skip the call. `bundle-require` takes esbuild as a peer dependency, so it runs the copy this package declares, which is the instance stopped.

The premise was re-measured on `origin/main` e8cba8fe before the change (built entry, SIGTERM to the `start` pid alone):

| Shape | `start` exit | group members alive at the exit | 2 s later |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| config project, before | code 0 at +66 ms | 1: `[esbuild]` (child of `serve`, reparented) | 0 |
| config project, after (3 runs) | code 0 at +84 / +62 / +74 ms | 0 | 0 |
| `--artifact` project, before | code 0 at +62 ms | 0 | 0 |

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/start-sigterm-process-group.integration.test.ts` (integration tier: spawns the built `bin/run.js`). It boots `start` on a `defineStack` config project in its own process group, checks that the probe sees `start` and `serve` in the group (positive control), sends SIGTERM to the `start` pid alone, and reads `kill(-pgid, 0)` in the exit handler: it must answer ESRCH, and the exit code must be 0 (the child's).
- Ablation: with the `stopConfigBundler()` call removed and the CLI rebuilt (`grep -c stopConfigBundler dist/commands/serve.js` = 0), the pin is red: `expected [ '8309  8270 [esbuild] <defunct>' ] to deeply equal []` and `kill(-pgid, 0) still found a member of the start process group at its exit`. Restored and rebuilt: 1 passed.
- The source entry (`bin/run-dev.js` under tsx) is not used by the pin: tsx's own esbuild service is a child of the `start` parent there and would be read as this defect.

No existing test was changed. One gate's census changed with it: `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` pins the exact set of test files that spawn the built entrypoint, and the new pin joins that set (twenty-one files become twenty-two), with an entry saying why it spawns the built entry. The gate's self-test and scan both pass at the head.

## Acceptance notes

- Card item 3 (document the behaviour if intended) does not apply: the behaviour was not intended and is fixed.

## Verification

Gate readings are in the os-dev report on the card.
